document.about: Three invented tables set as a filing sets its statements: a plain units caption in the label cell beside a bold, ruled head over a column pair; a blank label cell under one head; year heads ruled at half a point beside a plain caption.

notes: Written by hand; edit the HTML and the checks together.

checks.issue: A label cell in plain text made the header row read as data.
A row of one head, its label cell blank, was a band.
A border width starting with 0 (0.5pt) was read as no border.
